text: {"findings":[{"rule":"H1","where":"Token.forcedTransfer / MaxBalanceModule.moduleCheck","severity":"HIGH","why":"forcedTransfer moves tokens between wallets without calling compliance.transferred, so MaxBalanceModule never updates the per-identity balances. The receiving identity's recorded balance stays at 0 while its real balance rises, so the cap check on a later mint or transfer passes even though the real holding exceeds 1000.","steps":"1) agent mint(a1, 1000) -> idA record = 1000. 2) agent forcedTransfer(a1, b, 1000) -> real balance of b = 1000, but idB record stays 0 and idA record stays 1000. 3) agent mint(b, 1000): moduleCheck sees 0 + 1000 <= 1000 and passes. 4) b now really holds 2000, above the 1000 cap."},{"rule":"H3","where":"Token.forcedTransfer (also reached through Token.recoveryAddress) / MaxBalanceModule.moduleTransferAction not called","severity":"HIGH","why":"forcedTransfer changes real balances but skips the compliance transferred hook, so MaxBalanceModule's _IDBalance records no longer match the real token balances for the sending and receiving identities.","steps":"1) agent mint(a1, 1000) -> idA record = 1000. 2) agent forcedTransfer(a1, b, 1000) -> real: a1 = 0, b = 1000. 3) MaxBalanceModule.getIDBalance(compliance, idA) still returns 1000 and getIDBalance(compliance, idB) returns 0, which do not match the real balances."}]}
